prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding sequences is effective (moving sign-in won +12.0%; story-first flow won +3.1%), though impact can be overestimated (+8.0% predicted vs +3.1% measured).
Account safety copy changes on sign-in are helpful (+3.5% won), whereas general intro copy updates showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns carry high risk: redesigning controls hurt performance (-10.1%, worse than predicted -1.0%), while adoption preview redesign showed no clear effect.
Notifications and waiting screen features showed no clear effect, and predictions of +3.0% to +5.0% were too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -4.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -10.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -2.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +12.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Registration Shift: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after completing pet adoption selection instead of before it. (why: Funnel data shows adoption drops significantly (60.9% conversion). Allowing users to select or create their pet first builds ownership before requiring account creation.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Selection Preparation Screen: Insert a photo selection guideline screen before photo upload to explain optimal image lighting and angles. (why: Support received multiple complaints regarding failed or distorted custom pet generation results during adoption.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Quick-Start Checklist Flow: Add an interactive task checklist step before final home completion detailing how to show, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support received multiple emails from users confused about desktop pet visibility and basic controls after completing setup.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Safety Reassurance: Update sign-in copy to explicitly confirm existing pets and data will be restored upon logging in. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint: Display an inline hint on the photo upload screen explaining best photo practices to ensure high-quality custom pets. (why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time & Progress Indicator: Show estimated remaining time and step progress on the pet preparation waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has a high median time (201s) and high mean (2336s), causing drop-off while waiting.)
6: [finish, layout] Checklist Overview for Final Desktop Introduction: Switch the home intro screen layout to a checklist style displaying basic pet care steps. (why: Only 64.8% finish the final step, and support emails report confusion regarding pet management after setup.)
7: [home, notification] Completion Ready Desktop Audio Alert: Enable desktop notification sound and alert when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: The average waiting step duration is over 38 minutes (2336s mean), indicating users leave the app unattended during processing.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in after key value steps previously yielded +12.0% lift and targets high adoption drop-off.
Adding full new screens introduces friction; adoption step redesigns historically regressed (-4.1%).
Interactive flows on finish step carry high UI redesign risk; past finish control redesign fell -10.1%.
Account persistence and safety copy updates on sign-in consistently perform well (+3.5% measured).
Low cost config update, but evidence from support is weak (only 3 tickets) and inline copy has minimal lift.
Waiting screen indicators have shown negligible impact (+0.3%) in prior tests despite high waiting times.
Layout overhauls on the finish step carry strong negative risk (-10.1% in historical finish tests).
Audio notifications previously resulted in negative conversion (-2.9%) on the home waiting step.
